retrieved_context: Luke Clark: Luke Stephen Clark (born 24 May 1994) is an English footballer who is plays for Curzon Ashton.  He can play either as a right back or as a central midfielder.

Curzon Ashton F.C.: Curzon Ashton Football Club is a semi-professional football club based in the market town of Ashton-under-Lyne, Greater Manchester, England, that competes in the National League North, the sixth-highest division overall in the English football league system, and are members of the Manchester County Football Association.  Nicknamed "the Nash", the club was founded in 1963 and moved to its current stadium, Tameside Stadium, in 2005.
